summary: Audio-visual deepfakes can spread misinformation and enable impersonation, undermining trust in digital media. However, existing datasets provide limited coverage of forgery operations and their combinations, constraining detector development and systematic evaluation.
takeaways: However, existing datasets provide limited coverage of forgery operations and their combinations, constraining detector development and systematic evaluation.
To assess its training value and enable fair comparisons, we develop DeepfakeBench-MM, which standardizes training and evaluation across 8 datasets and 10 detectors.
Experiments on data scale and pipeline coverage further support the value of large, diverse training data.
